conversion.method: Original 2d6 and 2d8 probabilities were apportioned to integer d100 bands by largest remainder. Where ordinary nearest-percent rounding would total 101, the central result is rounded down so each table totals exactly 100.
conversion.rowOrder: Increasing hab rating within each table. d100 bands are reassigned into contiguous Hab cutoffs; every roll at or above a table's Hab 3 cutoff has Hab 3.
